business_summary: Thinkingdom Media Group Ltd. engages in the planning, publication, and authorization of digital content products in China. The company offers foreign literature, Chinese literature, non-fiction works, and children's books. The company is also involved in film and television production; marketing; copyrights related business, such as book-to-film adaptation projects; production and promotion of audiobooks; and books retail activities. In addition, the company offers ebooks, audiobooks, and radio dramas. Thinkingdom Media Group Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is based in Beijing, China.
